kind: Additive scope qualification. Errata, not edits: no pinned file is modified.
trigger: Main (IRC, v150b dispatch notice) set a mandatory scope qualification: the published T1 control with m=36 constrains a T1-only lower-bound approach; it is NOT a universal cap on all T2 arrays or supports, and R6 must not be narrowed to m<=36 as a T2 theorem.
affected_wording: Every owner file that uses wording such as: 'v24 caps the ladder at m<=36'; 'capped at m<=36 by v24'; 'ladder ceiling m<=36 realized'; 'the m<=36 cap comes from the v24 control'; 'R6: all m>=9 (the v24 control caps the ladder at m<=36)'. This includes the standard packet header line of v76-v93, checkpoints 068, 071, 077 and 145, manifests v6-v11 and v18, and park-v2-addendum-22. A grep for these patterns over the owner root lists the files.
binding_reading: The v24 control is the published Tuscan-1(11) array of Etzion's Example 2. It has support m=36.
Consequence of the control: any lower bound 'm>=M0' proved by Tuscan-1-only reasoning (no distance-two condition) must have M0<=36. This limits a T1-only lower-bound approach, and nothing more.
It is NOT an upper cap on the supports of Tuscan-2 arrays, nor on the supports of all Tuscan-1 arrays. It is NOT a theorem about Tuscan-2 squares.
R6 is ALL supports m>=9, with no T2 cap. The only upper bound in use is the identity m+2N2+beta=110 (so m<=110).
For a Tuscan-2(11) square, if one exists, every support value m>=9 consistent with that identity remains open.
unchanged: Every mathematical body, pin and finding is unchanged, including the frozen v150b gate scope (manifest v18 through v93) and the older v114 freeze. Packets from v94 on are separate from the v150b freeze and use the corrected reading.
